choose.option_builtin: Use the built-in MQTT broker (no external broker needed)
choose.builtin_intro: This app runs its own MQTT broker on Homey. Set up the Watts Live module (over Bluetooth with nRF Connect) to send to Homey: Hostname = the Homey IP address below, the port below, Transport = TCP, and the login if one is required. Then restart the module. The meter appears below within about a minute.
choose.builtin_help: Step-by-step guide: app settings → Help. Port and login are changed in the app settings.
choose.builtin_off: Off – will be turned on when you continue

loading.title: Discovering Devices
loading.subtitle: Homey is searching for Watts Live devices on MQTT.

errors.listen: The built-in broker cannot use port __port__ (__code__). Another app may be using it. Retrying every minute.
errors.not_running: The built-in MQTT broker is not running. Check the app settings.

settings.intro: Watts Live can send its measurements directly to Homey, without the MQTT Client app or an external broker. See the Help tab for how to set up the Watts Live module.
settings.enabled_hint: Only needed for devices that use the connection type Built-in MQTT broker. Devices using the MQTT Client app or a custom broker are not affected.
settings.port_hint: The port Watts Live sends to. Default is 1883 – it must match Port on the Watts Live module.
settings.login_hint: Leave both fields empty for no login. If you fill them in, the Watts Live module must use exactly the same Username and Password, otherwise it is rejected.
settings.port_invalid: The port must be a whole number between 1 and 65535
